subject: ci: sign the Windows embeddable archive in the same SignPath request as the MSIs (#4219)
summary: Bundles the Windows MSI installers and the Windows embeddable zip (containing lemond.exe and lemonade.exe) into a single unsigned artifact for one SignPath signing request, then publishes the signed embeddable zip for stable releases and the unsigned zip for release candidates.
verdict_reason: Low-risk CI-only change with all CI checks passing and no breaking user-facing behavior, though the review was thin.
